Whether **Morning Recovery** works depends on what you expect: independent medical evidence for hangover supplements is limited, though the maker cites a clinical study and many users report milder next-day symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX-jcud5SlNW-TXUXArgb_RLFEk95BzUBGXOZTcD5Jtbt-aVjhfVZqPhWg5xzTkgonrJ9kwcqI2T6lhT-vM8m1m2WsALmUwDIF_iQINrkhEAv1QnrAFEhWjijqE8TzAk7X1e31jcwwBP8XvAKG9C8rIQpD_LR6Wgu8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXfoq6aQjqMlsKfuPYppEph-vwR7mNURzbghnWqeTQb8pSQ6PGPWIO7BrYx5Cvgtm6Lsf60zfMl6tBdm4irs-DLoTsQmxTtHMjLjpMow8-0RUlJW3v_qYf3QnJvGflbJpj1LSTd7o)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESowEBxCJF10lcluIAMEMszssgSy_f-K8MIFYvgnRevJEZdeg_zovQooWRdMG5c_OMfXIobhmR9yRYKFyOjOeafieIex5bOQ2928gPFZRFyOjNU1piy4mgUA6l5sUpS31kNTiaVrssAQC_61SzlQb5ClJZvh4kAMCI5mhMevZC-FDQHULG4mdkXKQxlkO2Gt_ND_8oPpyDm3fk8ZiUsnelMxY_6jg8)

### What the Evidence Says

- **Independent medical view:** As [Northwestern Medicine](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1-I49KeOA4Vxrm0Br1srjuQHBhv_JeeIuydXC75qhXX8H5UXva7Z3F49VIZADf4-kvdqNdwCrYF5IxHyESbB1ySyFzDMQOrGbOwqZymXxbvHd5T9B5fGobIHGyW6xZX_ko07KZRbhgF6R_BVJGn8nW19g-Npynw9XkyBR6gTvA) notes, dietary supplements for hangovers are not FDA-approved to prevent or cure hangovers, and strong independent human trials are lacking. Similarly, [Bon Appétit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXfoq6aQjqMlsKfuPYppEph-vwR7mNURzbghnWqeTQb8pSQ6PGPWIO7BrYx5Cvgtm6Lsf60zfMl6tBdm4irs-DLoTsQmxTtHMjLjpMow8-0RUlJW3v_qYf3QnJvGflbJpj1LSTd7o) highlights that herbal formulas lack robust proof of effectiveness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1-I49KeOA4Vxrm0Br1srjuQHBhv_JeeIuydXC75qhXX8H5UXva7Z3F49VIZADf4-kvdqNdwCrYF5IxHyESbB1ySyFzDMQOrGbOwqZymXxbvHd5T9B5fGobIHGyW6xZX_ko07KZRbhgF6R_BVJGn8nW19g-Npynw9XkyBR6gTvA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXfoq6aQjqMlsKfuPYppEph-vwR7mNURzbghnWqeTQb8pSQ6PGPWIO7BrYx5Cvgtm6Lsf60zfMl6tBdm4irs-DLoTsQmxTtHMjLjpMow8-0RUlJW3v_qYf3QnJvGflbJpj1LSTd7o)
- **Key ingredients:** Morning Recovery contains dihydromyricetin (DHM from *Hovenia dulcis* ), milk thistle, prickly pear, ginseng, B and C vitamins, and electrolytes. Most DHM research comes from animal or cell studies, with weak human evidence.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXLxXvCIxHgwtsWwZ1N9nT4C517l-k63Y92tO9e-j5laezbVnDaQAqnqyo36AILeJct6V5pZcT815P2TLvRE_wdScsL_RGJTaeghvSnpYb4SFFh-uyGp9LL7mT-Lf-nMdTc0aJcBFp)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1wLhCzQ3NdITlVSfmgAVyLkUp9UPt19kTmWAqDz3fe0VYDgGyjTmg4Zgon7DD4HBpkZvfGTCuQ9W-aWyla7lrTTiwgUQ49Jzrt-7M497kIsEzEIIsaPgKu8Dz09Xygs5jxeXd3B-ceKs5F_2zlqD8WmZAwrzzUx3NSKnwbzod6ukbkY)
- **Company findings & limits:** More Labs reports that users in its clinical study saw up to an 80% improvement in certain symptoms (like headache and concentration) compared to placebo. However, the drink does not prevent intoxication, lower blood alcohol safely, or protect your liver from heavy drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEBxCJF1y_FDdhby8d2Xu2traQZ8nVyP_9eAQjU1Wjl-A3GCAfH-gPkrtDvV0q4Kw791IVZ6L0ViRdW8xagBNldwo3dbzRsi3hYQo3GCU6eciLKmYXEvsxMV92zLFy5vzyLBFVUVIlO8umqzdfKESQqRJ-whmrCnApUFGhE3tE1GbZMITfa0nhvIuotQMUNJcEz9gPU-EaIR1hzkcm7tXUuT-MsNWLpEquX)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX-jcud5SlNW-TXUXArgb_RLFEk95BzUBGXOZTcD5Jtbt-aVjhfVZqPhWg5xzTkgonrJ9kwcqI2T6lhT-vM8m1m2WsALmUwDIF_iQINrkhEAv1QnrAFEhWjijqE8TzAk7X1e31jcwwBP8XvAKG9C8rIQpD_LR6Wgu8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1-I49KeOA4Vxrm0Br1srjuQHBhv_JeeIuydXC75qhXX8H5UXva7Z3F49VIZADf4-kvdqNdwCrYF5IxHyESbB1ySyFzDMQOrGbOwqZymXxbvHd5T9B5fGobIHGyW6xZX_ko07KZRbhgF6R_BVJGn8nW19g-Npynw9XkyBR6gTvA)

### What Users Report

- Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESowEBxCJF10lcluIAMEMszssgSy_f-K8MIFYvgnRevJEZdeg_zovQooWRdMG5c_OMfXIobhmR9yRYKFyOjOeafieIex5bOQ2928gPFZRFyOjNU1piy4mgUA6l5sUpS31kNTiaVrssAQC_61SzlQb5ClJZvh4kAMCI5mhMevZC-FDQHULG4mdkXKQxlkO2Gt_ND_8oPpyDm3fk8ZiUsnelMxY_6jg8) agree in a consensus that Morning Recovery helps prevent or reduce next-day hangover symptoms, even after notable drinking.
- Reviews covered by [InsideHook](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1wLhCzQ3NdITlVSfmgAVyLkUp9UPt19kTmWAqDz3fe0VYDgGyjTmg4Zgon7DD4HBpkZvfGTCuQ9W-aWyla7lrTTiwgUQ49Jzrt-7M497kIsEzEIIsaPgKu8Dz09Xygs5jxeXd3B-ceKs5F_2zlqD8WmZAwrzzUx3NSKnwbzod6ukbkY) similarly note fewer headaches and milder hangovers overall, though mild stomach upset can still happen.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1wLhCzQ3NdITlVSfmgAVyLkUp9UPt19kTmWAqDz3fe0VYDgGyjTmg4Zgon7DD4HBpkZvfGTCuQ9W-aWyla7lrTTiwgUQ49Jzrt-7M497kIsEzEIIsaPgKu8Dz09Xygs5jxeXd3B-ceKs5F_2zlqD8WmZAwrzzUx3NSKnwbzod6ukbkY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESowEBxCJF10lcluIAMEMszssgSy_f-K8MIFYvgnRevJEZdeg_zovQooWRdMG5c_OMfXIobhmR9yRYKFyOjOeafieIex5bOQ2928gPFZRFyOjNU1piy4mgUA6l5sUpS31kNTiaVrssAQC_61SzlQb5ClJZvh4kAMCI5mhMevZC-FDQHULG4mdkXKQxlkO2Gt_ND_8oPpyDm3fk8ZiUsnelMxY_6jg8)

### Practical Takeaways

- It is meant to be taken **before or while drinking** , not as a replacement for food, water, or moderation.
- Check with a doctor first if you take medications or have liver or health conditions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXZB7QS6emLQZPrVsLchj-_RreD5qut-9tHl5xMSqJB94HiVQJm-b_VtYlmQQUi7_TnDPuDUlrwK0X0G9wJbF7VoYBZNvXVwvvBRIy7MMGk6ANdUdj42m-QbcjTkqwsJKAESVIPyb1a1E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX-jcud5SlNW-TXUXArgb_RLFEk95BzUBGXOZTcD5Jtbt-aVjhfVZqPhWg5xzTkgonrJ9kwcqI2T6lhT-vM8m1m2WsALmUwDIF_iQINrkhEAv1QnrAFEhWjijqE8TzAk7X1e31jcwwBP8XvAKG9C8rIQpD_LR6Wgu8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1-I49KeOA4Vxrm0Br1srjuQHBhv_JeeIuydXC75qhXX8H5UXva7Z3F49VIZADf4-kvdqNdwCrYF5IxHyESbB1ySyFzDMQOrGbOwqZymXxbvHd5T9B5fGobIHGyW6xZX_ko07KZRbhgF6R_BVJGn8nW19g-Npynw9XkyBR6gTvA)
